name: EntropyChain Official Logo #1
description: Official EntropyChain brand logo. A modern minimalist blockchain identity featuring interconnected blocks forming a swirling entropy vortex — symbolizing verifiable randomness, Argon2id PoW, and unbiased entropy per block. Created with Grok Imagine for the EntropyChain project (entropychain.io). Dark cyberpunk aesthetic with glowing neon cyan and purple accents.
